svg.title: Vanguard-M Missile Boat - interpreted silhouette
svg.desc: Small Craft Catalogue (2023), printed 95-96, PDF 96-97. Common Vanguard exterior traced from both plans and same-hull source text. Weapon/internal arrangement changes do not change this simplified envelope. Larger Deck 1 includes broad aft aerofoils and twin rear drives; Deck 2 is contained. Fine barbette barrels and room/missile-storage borders excluded.
